job.job_title: AI/ML Software Engineer Apprenticeship - LLM || Python || MCP
job.job_description:
NIIT is hiring for AI/ML Software Engineer role for Gurgaon location . It is WFO role.




Freshers with Graduation can also apply.




Contact - 7302533421

Share your CV on Hayatt.khan@niitmts.com




What You'll Work On:



- Building and integrating AI-powered applications and workflows
- Developing and consuming MCP (Model Context Protocol) Servers to connect AI models with real-world tools and data sources
- Writing clean, efficient code in Node.js and Python for AI pipelines and APIs
- Collaborating with the team to prototype and ship AI features quickly



What We're Looking For:



- Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
- Hands-on experience with AI/ML projects (college projects, hackathons, personal builds all count)
- Proficiency in Python and/or Node.js
- Familiarity with MCP Servers, LLM APIs (OpenAI Anthropic, etc.), or AI agent frameworks is a strong plus
- Self-driven, curious, and comfortable working with fast-moving AI tools and technologies



Nice to Have:



- Experience with REST APIs, prompt engineering, or RAG pipelines
- Contributions to open-source AI projects
- Exposure to tools like LangChain, or similar frameworks



Contact: Hayatt Khan 7302533421

Hayatt.khan@niitmts.com




Interested candidates can share their profiles or connect directly!
